title: Bell Stair
shortDescription: A tight oak stair turns down from the empty bell frame.
longDescription:
The stair leaves the Clock Tower in a tight coil. Oak steps are polished by older feet than yours. Fine silk has caught on the newel and shakes when the gears above turn.
The humming is louder here. It is not a swinging bell. Something below is answering the wood.

fixtures.name: Stair Rope
fixtures.examineDescription: The hand-rope is hemp over living oak. Three slow pulses travel up the grain — the same count you felt in the empty frame. Fresh silk has caught on the newel. That silk was not here when the bell still hung. Alder will want this named, not guessed.
